text.opengl: Implement Blinn-Phong in the `if (blinn)` branch of `advanced_lighting.fs` – the halfway vector between the light and view directions, `spec` = its dot product with the normal (at least 0) to the power 8.0 – and switch the program to it: `bool blinn = true;`.
text.vulkan: Implement Blinn-Phong in the `if (pc.blinn)` branch of `advanced_lighting.frag` – the halfway vector between the light and view directions, `spec` = its dot product with the normal (at least 0) to the power 8.0 – and switch the program to it: `bool blinn = true;`.
text.d3d12: Implement Blinn-Phong in the `if (blinn)` branch of `PSMain` – the halfway vector between the light and view directions, `spec` = its dot product with the normal (at least 0) to the power 8.0 – and switch the program to it: `bool blinn = true;`.

hint.opengl: `vec3 halfwayDir = normalize(lightDir + viewDir);` then `spec = pow(max(dot(normal, halfwayDir), 0.0), 8.0);`. The Phong `else` branch stays; `shader.setInt("blinn", blinn)` sends the flag every frame.
hint.vulkan: `vec3 halfwayDir = normalize(lightDir + viewDir);` then `spec = pow(max(dot(normal, halfwayDir), 0.0), 8.0);`. The Phong `else` branch stays; `recordCommandBuffer()` pushes the flag as a `VkBool32`.
hint.d3d12: `float3 halfwayDir = normalize(lightDir + viewDir);` then `spec = pow(max(dot(normal, halfwayDir), 0.0f), 8.0f);`. The Phong `else` branch stays; `SetGraphicsRoot32BitConstant(0, blinn, 0)` sends the flag every frame.

text.opengl: Raise the Blinn-Phong exponent from 8.0 to 32.0, learnopengl's value.
text.vulkan: Raise the Blinn-Phong exponent from 8.0 to 32.0, learnopengl's value.
text.d3d12: Raise the Blinn-Phong exponent from `8.0f` to `32.0f`, learnopengl's value.

hint.opengl: `spec = pow(max(dot(normal, halfwayDir), 0.0), 32.0);` – the angle between the normal and the halfway vector is smaller than Phong's angle, so Blinn-Phong needs 2–4 times the exponent for the same highlight size.
hint.vulkan: `spec = pow(max(dot(normal, halfwayDir), 0.0), 32.0);` – the angle between the normal and the halfway vector is smaller than Phong's angle, so Blinn-Phong needs 2–4 times the exponent for the same highlight size.
hint.d3d12: `spec = pow(max(dot(normal, halfwayDir), 0.0f), 32.0f);` – the angle between the normal and the halfway vector is smaller than Phong's angle, so Blinn-Phong needs 2–4 times the exponent for the same highlight size.

ex-specular-only.text: Show only the specular term: draw the floor with nothing but the highlight, so you can see the shape Blinn-Phong gives it.

hint.opengl: One line at the end of `advanced_lighting.fs`: write `specular` instead of `ambient + diffuse + specular` to `FragColor`.
hint.vulkan: One line at the end of `advanced_lighting.frag`: write `specular` instead of `ambient + diffuse + specular` to `outColor`.
hint.d3d12: One line at the end of `PSMain`: return `specular` instead of `ambient + diffuse + specular`.

ex-blue-light.text: Give the light a cool blue colour, (0.3, 0.6, 1.0), so that both its diffuse light and its highlight are tinted blue (the ambient light stays as it is).

hint.opengl: In the fragment shader: a `vec3 lightColor` that `diffuse` and `specular` are multiplied by, component by component, before they are added up.
hint.vulkan: In the fragment shader: a `vec3 lightColor` that `diffuse` and `specular` are multiplied by, component by component, before they are added up.
hint.d3d12: In `PSMain`: a `float3 lightColor` that `diffuse` and `specular` are multiplied by, component by component, before they are added up.

ex-move-light.text: Move the light two units to the left, to (−2, 0, 0), and watch the lit part of the floor and its highlight follow it.

hint.opengl: Only `lightPos` in `main.cpp` changes; it is sent to the shader every frame.
hint.vulkan: Only the global `lightPos` in `main.cpp` changes; `updateUniformBuffer()` copies it into the uniform buffer every frame.
hint.d3d12: Only the global `lightPos` in `main.cpp` changes; the constant buffer gets it every frame.

ex-two-lights.text: Add a second white light at (−1.5, 0, −1), lit with Blinn-Phong just like the first: its diffuse light and its highlight are added to the first light's.

hint.opengl: A `lightPos2` in `main.cpp`, sent with `shader.setVec3`, and a `uniform vec3 lightPos2;` in the fragment shader. There: its own light direction and halfway vector, then `diffuse +=` and `specular +=` with the same formulas as the first light.
hint.vulkan: A `lightPos2` in `main.cpp` and in the uniform block – in both the C++ struct (after `pad2`, followed by another float of padding: std140) and the shader's `UniformBufferObject`. In the shader: its own light direction and halfway vector, then `diffuse +=` and `specular +=` with the same formulas as the first light.
hint.d3d12: A `lightPos2` in `main.cpp` and in the constant buffer – in both `SceneConstantBuffer` (after `padding1`, followed by another float of padding) and the HLSL `cbuffer`. In `PSMain`: its own light direction and halfway vector, then `diffuse +=` and `specular +=` with the same formulas as the first light.
